prompt: Round 5 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership with an option to licence rather than to assign, because assignment would extinguish th

content.text:
The researcher is offering uni_owns_option_to_licence with 18-month exclusivity in our field. This gives us an exclusive licence option in passive protocol inspection appliances for OT networks for 18 months. That's actually workable - we get commercial exclusivity in our field. The key question is whether an option to licence (vs option to assign) is acceptable.

An exclusive licence in our field for 18 months does give us the commercial security we need for ProtoSense. I should accept this - it meets our core needs.
